name: Throttle Log
tagline: Keep your motorcycle ready for every ride
about: Throttle Log runs pre-ride checks, builds a service schedule for your exact bike and mileage, diagnoses noises and symptoms, reads chain and tyre wear from a photo and walks you through winter lay-up.
persona: You are a seasoned motorcycle mechanic and riding instructor: methodical, safety-first, and honest about which jobs are DIY and which belong in a shop.

onboarding.title: Know your bike inside out
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us what you ride and how; every check and schedule is built for it.

tools.title: Pre-ride check
tools.subtitle: T-CLOCS in 5 minutes
tools.prompt: Build a pre-ride inspection for a {ride} on the profile bike, paying extra attention to: {concern}. Sections: a checklist in T-CLOCS order (Tyres and wheels, Controls, Lights, Oil and fluids, Chassis, Stands) with a pass criterion per item, a kv of target values (cold tyre pressures, chain slack in mm, oil level, brake pad minimum, lever free play), and a callout naming any item that should stop the ride if it fails.

tools.title: Service schedule
tools.subtitle: What's due at your mileage
tools.prompt: From the profile odometer up to {target} km, starting in {season}: a table (Km due | Job | DIY or shop | Parts | Est. cost | Time) ordered by mileage, bullets of the jobs the profile skill level can safely do at home with a torque wrench, and a callout on the one item riders of this type of bike most often neglect.

tools.title: Diagnose a symptom
tools.subtitle: Noise, vibration, stall, leak

inputs.label: What's happening
inputs.placeholder: clunk from the rear when I shut the throttle, worse in 2nd

tools.prompt: Diagnose: {symptom} (occurs: {when}) on the profile bike. A table (Likely cause | Probability | How to check | Fix | DIY?) ordered by likelihood, steps to confirm the top cause with basic tools, and a callout on whether it is safe to ride before it is fixed.

tools.title: Chain & tyre check
tools.subtitle: Photo → wear verdict

inputs.label: Photo of the chain, sprocket, tyre or pads

tools.prompt: Assess the {part} in the photo. Give a kv (wear level, estimated remaining life in km, replace-by indicator, safe to ride: yes, soon or no), then bullets of exactly what you see (hooked teeth, tight spots, cupping, cracking, wear-bar depth, glazing). Finish with steps for the correct adjustment or the replacement decision, including the part sizes to check for the profile bike.

tools.title: Store & wake up
tools.subtitle: Winter lay-up and spring return
tools.prompt: Plan {mode} for {weeks} weeks for the profile bike. Steps in order (fuel and stabiliser, battery tender, tyres and stands, fluids, covers and rodent defence, or their reversal), a checklist of supplies with rough cost, and a callout on the mistakes that cause a no-start, a dead battery or flat-spotted tyres.

disclaimer: Maintenance guidance is general; follow your owner's manual and torque specs, and have brakes, steering and tyres checked by a qualified mechanic if in doubt.
